detail.longDescription: "86% of CIOs are leaving the cloud" is the most quoted statistic in hosting this year. We're a hosting company and we think it's nonsense. It comes from a 2024 survey, and it counts a CIO moving one batch job the same as one closing the AWS account. Full exits were about 8-9%. What's really happening is duller: people are moving the two or three workloads that never belonged there. https://www. blendbyte.com/blog/cloud-repat riation-86-percent-statistic # Cloud # AWS # SelfHosted # DevOps
